title: Version 3.1.2 Changelog
items: Fix active session presence and IP refresh
Optimize encrypted storage and quota accounting
Add indexed cursor pagination and virtualized lists
Move maintenance and bulk operations to workers
Bound cache, sharing, and session fanout
Stream Electron uploads without plaintext staging
Move durable file work to background worker
Fix mobile recent file name overflow
Make object storage portable across S3 and R2
Fix immediate refresh after sharing files
